title.narrative: 217898_Host for Start Network Programme(s) in Zimbabwe: ARC Replica in Zimbabwe 2021-2023

description.narrative:
Start Network led project, funded by ARC Replica. This PIMS entry is for inception phase, not implementation, World Vision Zimbabwe has been selected as the host for the ARC call.
PLEASE NOTE: This 'project' is simply a hosting arrangement and there is no implementation going on in Zimbabwe. This means that there are no beneficiary numbers to upload or project or impact documents to upload. The host arrangement means that WVUK, through WV Zimbabwe provide logistical support to SN staff members in Zimbabwe as SN do not have physical offices in Zimbabwe. WVZ provide office space, support recruitment of staff, provide HR, IT and other logistical support, so while staff are employed by SN, they are also WV staff. If there is implementation as a result of the work that the SN staff are doing, a new project will be set up with beneficiary numbers. On this current page, there will not be any beneficiary numbers posted at any point.
